NOTES: Most merchants at $100-200K/month are on Fiserv Elavon or Worldpay mid-market pricing. The statement-gap pitch works because owners almost never calculate their true blended rate. One signed merchant with a real before-and-after number becomes the strongest asset for all future outreach.
